title: Jacob Wrestles an Angel
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child narrates Genesis 32:22-30: Jacob sends his family across the Jabbok, a man wrestles with him till daybreak, touches his hip, Jacob will not let go without a blessing, is renamed Israel, and calls the place Peniel; lessons: persistence in prayer, God changes people.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the friend at midnight kept asking.
floor.question: Why did the friend get up and give the loaves?

representations: a river ford drawn at night
steps: Jacob is alone at the Jabbok.
A man wrestles with him till dawn.
His hip is hurt; he holds on.
He is blessed and named Israel.
contexts: praying for a long time for a family need
not giving up on hard homework
a new start after a mistake

board.do: Write Genesis 32:26: "I will not let you go unless you bless me".
Point at the words "not let you go".
board.say: What does Jacob teach us about prayer?

board.do: Wait for the child to say keep on, be persistent.

listen_for: He was stronger than the man
misconceptions.repair: Read 32:25-26: the man touched his hip and Jacob still held on asking for a blessing.

misconceptions.ask: What new name did Jacob receive (Genesis 32:28)?
misconceptions.repair: Draw the family line: Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, then "Israel", Jacob's new name.

misconceptions.ask: Which river did Jacob's family cross (Genesis 32:22)?
misconceptions.repair: Read 32:22: the ford of the Jabbok. Write the name twice.
Read 32:31: he was limping because of his hip. He held on even when hurt.

checks.question: What new name did Jacob receive?
Why was Jacob blessed?
checks.answer: He held on and asked for a blessing
